nodes.name: LspClient.ts
nodes.summary: Frontend LSP client wrapper that talks to the Rust backend over Tauri commands (lsp_start_server, lsp_did_open/change/close, lsp_shutdown) and receives diagnostics via the code-editor WebSocket rather than Tauri events, with per-URI listener routing and a retry/backoff subscription loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Diagnostics arrive out-of-band via a WebSocket subscription (exponential backoff up to 5 retries) rather than through Tauri's event system, decoupling document sync (via invoke) from diagnostic delivery (via WS broadcast).

nodes.name: LspClientManager.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton manager that lazily creates and caches one LspClient per base language, normalizes language variants (e.g. scss/sass/less to css) to match the Rust-side server routing, and caches install-hint lookups so the UI doesn't repeatedly nag about missing language server binaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Map-based client pool keyed by normalized base language, with a separate install-hint cache keyed the same way to avoid redundant Tauri round-trips to lsp_check_installed.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript interfaces mirroring the Rust-side LSP types (Position, Range, Diagnostic, CompletionItem, Location, Hover) plus a converter that maps raw LSP diagnostics into the app's internal Diagnostic shape used by the Problems panel.

nodes.name: LspClient
nodes.summary: Per-language LSP client that starts/stops a language server via Tauri, tracks open documents and version numbers for didOpen/didChange/didClose, and routes incoming diagnostics to per-URI listeners or a fallback handler.

nodes.name: LspClientManager
nodes.summary: Manages the pool of LspClient instances (one per base language), wires each new client's fallback diagnostic handler into the global diagnostics store, and exposes install-hint lookup/invalidation and bulk shutdown.

nodes.name: lspDiagnosticToAppDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Converts a raw LSP diagnostic (0-based positions, numeric severity) into the app's Diagnostic type used by the Problems panel, mapping severity codes to labels and generating a stable id from file path and position.
